label: wargate-lowthr-n1
_why:
DOES THE WAR GATE MECHANISM WORK AT ALL? (user, 2026-08-18.) The 50000-casualty probe cannot distinguish "mechanism broken" from "threshold too high for 1846", and a zero there would leave both live. This drops front_casualties_min to 100 and changes NOTHING else, so a completion here isolates the mechanism.

OBSERVABLE: PMR_JE|<stage>|<tech>|<country> is logged when a journal entry completes. War bars are max_value 6 at +1 per qualifying month, so six qualifying months complete one - well inside a three-year run.

⚠ WHAT A ZERO WOULD STILL NOT PROVE. The gate needs an ENEMY GENERAL ON THE FRONT WHOSE OWNER HOLDS A TECHNOLOGY WE LACK. In a CIVIL war the breakaway side usually starts with the parent's technologies, so a tech differential may simply not exist - Brazil's 1836 war (the Ragamuffin revolt) is exactly that shape. A zero here therefore points at the tech clause, not necessarily at the plumbing, and the follow-up is a probe relaxing THAT clause.
_arms: lowthr = {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.wargate_lowthr.json} - the shipped config with ONE value changed: front_casualties_min 50000 -> 100. NOT a shipping candidate.
_comparison: Not an arm comparison - a variance envelope on one config. It supersedes, at monthly resolution, the annual 1837-1841 rows read off 20260817_155024 (which is a DIFFERENT arm: all-subject grants) and the three-month window of 20260817_211818 (same arm, too short).
_caveats: ⚠ Monthly autosaves are the point of the run, and they are not free: the engine stalls on every write, so this is slower per in-game year than a normal run. ⚠ Autosaves overwrite the user's own autosave*.v3 slots. ⚠ L19: check for an orphaned victoria3.exe before launching. ⚠ L17: a run that fails is still recorded `ok`; check each meta.json's reached_ingame_date before counting it. ⚠ Read building presence from SAVE SUMMARIES, never the building_inventory boot dump, whose ~12k-line burst overflows the log ring (the defect that voided 20260817_184413).
